# nico_infiniband_partition (Data Source)

InfiniBand (IB) is a high-performance, low-latency networking standard designed for interconnecting servers and storage in HPC (High-Performance Computing) and AI systems, utilizing RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) to reduce CPU overhead. InfiniBand Partitions are used to group Machines into logical partitions for network isolation and load distribution.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_infiniband_partition" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "infiniband_partition_name" {
  value = data.nico_infiniband_partition.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `infiniband_partition_id` (String) Filter InfiniBand Interfaces by InfiniBand Partition ID.  Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one ID.
- `instance_id` (String) Filter InfiniBand Interfaces by Instance ID.  Can be specified multiple times to filter on more than one ID.
- `query` (String) Search for matches across all InfiniBand Partitions. Input will be matched against name, description, and status fields
- `site_id` (String) Filter Partitions by Site
- `status` (String) Filter Partitions by Status

### Read-Only

- `controller_ib_partition_id` (String) ID of the Site Controller InfiniBand partition corresponding to this InfiniBand Partition
- `created` (String) Date/time when the InfiniBand Partition was created
- `description` (String) Description of the InfiniBand Partition
- `enable_sharp` (Boolean) Whether SHARP is enabled for the InfiniBand Partition
- `labels` (Map of String) String key-value pairs describing InfiniBand Partition labels. Up to 10 key-value pairs can be specified
- `mtu` (Number) MTU configured for the InfiniBand Partition
- `name` (String) Name of the InfiniBand Partition
- `partition_key` (String) Partition key assigned to the InfiniBand Partition
- `partition_name` (String) Partition name assigned to the InfiniBand Partition
- `rate_limit` (Number) Rate limit configured for the InfiniBand Partition
- `service_level` (Number) Service level configured for the InfiniBand Partition
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Chronological status history for the InfiniBand Partition (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenant
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the InfiniBand Partition was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--status_history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_history`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Date/time when the associated entity assumed the status
- `message` (String) Description of the state and cause/remedy in case of error
- `status` (String) State of the associated entity at a particular time
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the associated entity was last observed with this status
